keyEvents.text: First Half ends, Everton 0, Coventry City 0.
Goal! Everton 0, Coventry City 1. Yann Gboho (Coventry City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Goal! Everton 1, Coventry City 1. Thierno Barry (Everton) header from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Vitalii Mykolenko with a cross.
Goal! Everton 2, Coventry City 1. Thierno Barry (Everton) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Everton. Jake O'Brien replaces Merlin Röhl.
Substitution, Everton. Hayden Hackney replaces Harrison Armstrong.
Substitution, Everton. Brennan Johnson replaces Tyler Dibling.
Substitution, Coventry City. Brandon Thomas-Asante replaces Yann Gboho.
Goal! Everton 3, Coventry City 1. Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) left footed shot from a difficult angle on the left to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Thierno Barry with a through ball.
Substitution, Coventry City. Matt Grimes replaces Victor Torp.
Substitution, Coventry City. Gustavo Hamer replaces Jack Rudoni.
Substitution, Coventry City. Loum Tchaouna replaces Tatsuhiro Sakamoto.
Substitution, Coventry City. Sidiki Cherif replaces Taiwo Awoniyi.
Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Caleb Yirenkyi (Coventry City) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Everton. Michael Keane replaces Jarrad Branthwaite.
Substitution, Everton. Charly Alcaraz replaces Tyrique George.
Second Half ends, Everton 3, Coventry City 1.
